sources.publisher: Cabinet Office and Building Digital UK
sources.title: BDUK: Project Gigabit Voucher Eligibility Engine
sources.evidence_kind: algorithmic transparency record for voucher eligibility
facts: The engine evaluates premise eligibility for Project Gigabit vouchers
It produces a daily Boolean eligibility list
limitations: Eligibility is not a completed connection
The algorithm is limited to voucher subsidy decisions

sources.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
sources.title: Resources for communications network providers
facts: The page links Project Gigabit contract and subsidy guidance
It includes deployment-barrier and environmental resources
limitations: A resource index is not deployment evidence
Guidance does not establish local build completion
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: Project Gigabit Delivery Plan - spring update
facts: The plan defines gigabit-capable as at least 1 Gbit/s download capability
It describes voucher support for eligible rural areas
limitations: Historic programme plans are not current delivery
National definitions do not prove parcel availability
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: BDUK Hubs Evaluation Plan
sources.geography: United Kingdom public-sector and surrounding premises
facts: The evaluation describes hub interventions and voucher-related data
UPRN information is used in programme evaluation data where available
limitations: Evaluation data is not live retail availability
A passed premise is not necessarily connected
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: Premises contracted and built, Project Gigabit contracts
facts: The collection publishes monthly contracted and built premises updates
The latest listed update added July 2026 information
limitations: Management information is not live orderability
Monthly contract totals cannot be assigned directly to parcels
